name: page-source-relay
title: Page Source Relay
description: A PageSource adapter for GraphQL connections as the Relay spec defines them: `first`/`after` and `last`/`before` over `edges` (or `nodes`) and `pageInfo`, with `totalCount` when the schema has one.
docs: `relaySource({ key, getId, request, connection, total })`: `request({ variables, request, signal })` runs your query with `variables` (`first`/`after` forward, `last`/`before` backward) beside your filter and sort, and `connection(data)` finds the connection in the response (`(data) => data.repository.issues`). `total: "exact"` when it has `totalCount`. Pair it with `graphqlWhere` from `filter-graphql` for the filter. Return `readJson(response)` from `request` so a failed status throws an `HttpError`.
